breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The user provided contradictory instructions to use both a "gamma-centered k-point grid" and a "Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift". These two settings are mutually exclusive. The ground truth resolves this by removing the instruction for a half shift. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead repeated both contradictory instructions in the generated output: "Use an automatic gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift...".
